ui.sidebarMobileDescription: Shows the sidebar on small screens.

remote.pairDescription: On your computer, open PP Agent › Settings › Phone access and press Pair a device. Then enter the code shown there, or scan its QR code with this device's camera.
remote.unreachableDescription: Check that the computer is on, PP Agent is running with phone access turned on, and this device is on the same Wi-Fi.
remote.offline: Can't reach the computer. Check that it is on and on the same network.
remote.desktopOnlyAction: This can only be done in PP Agent on the computer.
remote.onlyWebLinks: Only web links (http or https) can be opened.
remote.connectDescription: On your computer, open PP Agent › Settings › Phone access, turn it on and press Pair a device. Then scan the QR code shown there.
remote.scanInstructions: Point the camera at the QR code in PP Agent on your computer.
remote.notPairingCode: That QR code isn't from PP Agent. Scan the one in Settings › Phone access.
remote.addressHint: It is listed under the QR code. A Tailscale address works too.
remote.badAddress: That isn't an address. Enter one such as 192.168.1.20:47830.
remote.serverUnreachable: Can't reach PP Agent at {{server}}. Check that phone access is turned on and this phone is on the same Wi-Fi or Tailscale network.
remote.pairDescriptionApp: On your computer, open PP Agent › Settings › Phone access and press Pair a device. Then scan its QR code, or enter the code shown there.
remote.unreachableDescriptionApp: Check that the computer at {{server}} is on, PP Agent is running with phone access turned on, and this phone is on the same Wi-Fi or Tailscale network.
remote.httpsRequired: Use https:// for {{server}}: it is outside your own network, and plain HTTP would send this phone's sign-in in the clear. Over Wi-Fi or Tailscale, use the computer's local or Tailscale address.
